data.name: USD/VND Central Rate
data.description: Illustrative central USD/VND reference-rate series for testing daily FX monitoring.
data.methodology_note: Demo values only. Data date, publication date and fetch date remain separate.

data.name: USD/VND Bank Sell
data.methodology_note: Demo values only; no actual bank quote is represented.

data.name: Domestic Gold Buy
data.description: Domestic SJC gold-bar buying price in VND per tael.
data.methodology_note: Demo until a controlled production observation is persisted; production observations require corroborated evidence.

data.name: Domestic Gold Sell
data.description: Illustrative domestic gold selling-price series in VND per tael.

data.name: Global Gold
data.description: Illustrative global gold reference series in USD per ounce.

data.name: 12M Deposit Rate
data.description: Illustrative average 12-month VND deposit rate across a demo bank sample.
data.methodology_note: Demo average, not a live bank-rate survey.

data.name: Average Lending Rate
data.description: Illustrative average lending-rate series for testing macro monitoring.

data.name: Interbank Overnight Rate
data.description: Illustrative overnight interbank rate used as a liquidity signal.

data.name: Policy Refinancing Rate
data.description: State Bank of Vietnam refinancing policy rate. Demo values are used only until a controlled production observation is available.
data.methodology_note: Event-driven policy rate. Controlled production is displayed only after independent corroboration of the decision, effective date and rate.

data.name: Policy Rediscount Rate
data.description: State Bank of Vietnam rediscount policy rate.
data.methodology_note: Event-driven policy rate. Controlled production is displayed only after independent corroboration of the decision, effective date and rate.

data.name: SBV Overnight Lending Facility Rate
data.description: State Bank of Vietnam overnight lending / clearing-deficit facility rate. This is distinct from the market interbank overnight rate.
data.methodology_note: Event-driven administered policy rate. Controlled production requires independent corroboration of the decision, effective date and rate; it is never merged with the market interbank overnight series.

data.name: Bank Funding Growth YTD
data.description: Year-to-date growth in capital mobilization by Vietnamese credit institutions.
data.methodology_note: Official NSO banking activity observation. Production display is enabled only after the controlled promotion gate.

data.name: CPI YoY
data.methodology_note: Demo monthly inflation series; period and publication date are intentionally separated.

data.name: VND Deposit Rate 6–12M
data.description: Monthly VND deposit-rate range for 6–12 month tenors, reported from the SBV customer-rate bulletin.
data.methodology_note: Displayed as a low–high range. The frontend pairs separately promoted low/high production components; it never replaces the official range with a scalar average.

data.name: Average VND Lending Rate Range
data.description: Monthly range of average VND lending rates reported from the SBV customer-rate bulletin.
data.methodology_note: Displayed as a low–high range. The frontend pairs separately promoted low/high production components; it never collapses the official range into a single average.
